run_greeter_client: run the gRPC Greeter client that sends a SayHello request to localhost:50051
create_header_interceptor: create a header_adder_interceptor that injects a custom header key-value pair into gRPC requests
intercept_grpc_channel: wrap a gRPC channel with a custom interceptor using grpc.intercept_channel
create_insecure_channel: create an insecure gRPC channel to localhost:50051 using grpc.insecure_channel
call_sayhello_stub: call the GreeterStub SayHello method with a HelloRequest to receive a greeting response
